conventions.null: Unknown or not safely resolved. Null never means false. Empty specification arrays mean no verified entries, not confirmed absence.
conventions.ids: Stable normalized brand-model keys. Explicit source groups are not production models. Variants are distinct from regional aliases.
conventions.date: Release year/month come from a release/marketed source. Wikidata inception is separate and is not automatically a release date.
conventions.units: Millimeters, meters, grams, seconds, ISO, EV at ISO 100 when stated. 35mm-equivalent focal lengths are separate from physical focal lengths.
conventions.provenance: field_sources maps dotted field paths to source IDs; default covers source facts without a more specific mapping. Metadata-derived classification and brand inference are marked in quality.
conventions.quality: manufacturer_specs = parsed, not individually checked; manual_reviewed / manufacturer_reviewed = core specs reviewed; metadata_only = community model index.
conventions.copyright: No source photographs, scans, or full essays are included. Wikidata metadata is CC0. Other linked assets retain their owners’ rights; this dataset grants no rights to those assets.
